verdict.rationale: Xero ships a built-in AI assistant, JAX, that users can delegate tasks to. Per the vendor pages it categorizes and matches bank transactions, and it creates, edits and sends invoices from plain-language commands. In-product AI also extracts bill details into draft bills, and Xero says users can get instant answers about cash flow and profit. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of JAX's scope, limits and approval controls; plan availability; independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
